property_summary: For any actor depositing any positive amount, calling withdrawAll must pay out the full stored credit so that address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant never sends funds, so its contract balance remains equal to the deposit for some fuzzed amount.
change_summary: Replace `uint oCredit = credit[msg.sender];` with `uint oCredit = 0;` so withdrawAll never reads stored credit and never sends any funds.
